scope: One read-only Cloud Logging request for this revision over the preceding ten minutes; no application, database or ledger mutation.

readiness_body.source: Expected BudgetHTTPMiddleware denial; root separately observed this exact hash from the two live responses.

diagnosis: Both readiness failures are immediately followed by a dead-connection warning. PostgreSQL termination tests reproduced the same 503 in each API and dispatcher pool before checkout checking. The logs do not establish the reason PostgreSQL closed these connections.
fix: Validate connections at checkout before handing them to application or budget transactions. No transaction or network-effect retries were added.

validation.reproduction: service/test_idle_connections.py: 4 failed before the fix; every failure was 503 after terminating an idle server backend.
validation.focused: service/test_idle_connections.py service/test_budget_http.py: 37 passed after the fix.
validation.dispatch_and_serverless: service/test_dispatch.py service/test_serverless_api.py: 31 passed after the fix.
validation.budget_proof: Each recovered API request consumes exactly one invocation and its encoded response/overhead bytes. Each recovered dispatcher request consumes one invocation and one GCS allowance; no jobs are launched. An empty dispatch stays idle without another debit.
